claims.evidence: Witness read panel text as 'PSR-175' but confirmed true model is PSR-275; panel text was ambiguous and seller's model claim does not match the actual model.

claims.claim: working perfectly / used but working perfectly well
claims.evidence: No audio, power-on, or key-press video provided; LCD and speakers cannot be confirmed functional from a static photo.

risks.risk: Model number mismatch (seller/witness say PSR-175, actual is PSR-275) changes price tier.
risks.proof: Clear, well-lit close-up or zoom photo of the full model text on the control panel.
risks.if_unproven: priced as the lower-value/ambiguous model (worst case)

risks.proof: Photo showing the adapter next to the keyboard or plugged in.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unit only, no adapter

risks.risk: Key and button functionality unverified (sticking keys, dead buttons, LCD defects).
risks.proof: Short video of seller playing a scale across all octaves and cycling through panel buttons/voices with LCD visible.

risks.risk: Hidden cosmetic damage (cracks, scratches, broken speaker grille) outside current angle.
risks.proof: Additional photos from top, back, and both side angles, plus speaker grille close-up.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having undisclosed cosmetic damage

risks.risk: Unknown age/usage history affecting wear and lifespan.
risks.proof: Serial number photo or purchase receipt, if available.
risks.if_unproven: priced as heavily used, unknown age

proof_requests: Clear zoomed photo of the full model number on the control panel
Video of the keyboard powering on, playing a scale across all keys, and cycling through panel buttons/voices
Photo of power adapter/cable if included
Additional angle photos: top, back, both sides, and speaker grilles close-up
Photo of serial number or any purchase documentation
response.reason: The witness confirms the item is a Yamaha electronic keyboard, so it can be priced at worst case given unresolved model ambiguity and unverified functionality, pending the listed proofs.
